# Read pipeline metrics and save CSV

```{r build-cfdna-metrics-csv}
results_dir <- file.path(project_dir, "analysis", "cfDNA", "result")
raw_dir <- file.path(project_dir, "raw_data")
metrics_csv <- file.path(raw_dir, "cfDNA_10x_barplot_metrics.csv")

sample_order <- paste0("FYM_260410_S", sprintf("%02d", 1:12))

library_conc_values <- c(
  15.37,
  12.84,
  18.06,
  10.92,
  17.43,
  19.15,
  24.63,
  17.19,
  21.85,
  29.42,
  23.07,
  26.58
)

library_df <- tibble(
  sample = sample_order,
  library_conc = library_conc_values
)

# ----------------------------
# 1. Genomic coverage from samtools coverage
# ----------------------------
read_samtools_genome_coverage <- function(f) {
  sample <- basename(f) %>%
    str_remove("\\.coverage\\.txt$")

  x <- data.table::fread(f)
  names(x) <- sub("^#", "", names(x))

  required_cols <- c("rname", "startpos", "endpos", "covbases")
  missing_cols <- setdiff(required_cols, names(x))
  if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
    stop(
      "Missing columns in samtools coverage file: ",
      paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", "),
      "\nFile: ", f
    )
  }

  x <- x %>%
    filter(rname %in% genome_chr) %>%
    mutate(
      startpos = as.numeric(startpos),
      endpos = as.numeric(endpos),
      covbases = as.numeric(covbases),
      region_len = endpos - startpos + 1
    )

  if (nrow(x) == 0) {
    stop("No chr1-22 records found in samtools coverage file: ", f)
  }

  genome_length <- sum(x$region_len, na.rm = TRUE)
  genome_covbases <- sum(x$covbases, na.rm = TRUE)

  tibble(
    sample = sample,
    genomic_coverage = 100 * genome_covbases / genome_length
  )
}

coverage_files <- list.files(
  file.path(results_dir, "qc", "samtools_coverage"),
  pattern = "\\.coverage\\.txt$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

if (length(coverage_files) == 0) {
  stop("No samtools coverage files found.")
}

coverage_df <- map_dfr(coverage_files, read_samtools_genome_coverage)

# ----------------------------
# 2. Covered CpGs from final TAPS-direction bedGraph
# ----------------------------
read_covered_cpg <- function(f) {
  sample <- basename(f) %>%
    str_remove("\\.minTotal3\\.filter_taps\\.summary\\.tsv$")

  data.table::fread(f) %>%
    transmute(
      sample = sample,
      covered_cpgs = as.numeric(covered_cpg_minTotal3)
    )
}

covered_cpg_df <- list.files(
  file.path(results_dir, "05methy_call", "summary"),
  pattern = "\\.minTotal3\\.filter_taps\\.summary\\.tsv$",
  full.names = TRUE
) %>%
  map_dfr(read_covered_cpg)

# ----------------------------
# 3. Duplication rate from Picard MarkDuplicates metrics
# ----------------------------
read_picard_duplication <- function(f) {
  sample <- basename(f) %>%
    str_remove("\\.metrics\\.txt$") %>%
    str_remove("\\.dedup$")

  lines <- readLines(f, warn = FALSE)

  header_i <- which(str_detect(lines, "^LIBRARY\\t"))[1]
  if (is.na(header_i)) {
    stop("Cannot find Picard metrics header starting with LIBRARY in: ", f)
  }

  data_i <- header_i + 1
  if (data_i > length(lines) || lines[data_i] == "") {
    stop("Cannot find Picard metrics data row in: ", f)
  }

  x <- data.table::fread(
    text = paste(lines[header_i], lines[data_i], sep = "\n"),
    sep = "\t",
    header = TRUE
  )

  if (!"PERCENT_DUPLICATION" %in% names(x)) {
    stop("PERCENT_DUPLICATION not found in Picard metrics file: ", f)
  }

  tibble(
    sample = sample,
    duplication_rate = as.numeric(x$PERCENT_DUPLICATION[1])
  )
}

dup_files <- list.files(
  file.path(results_dir, "04dedup"),
  pattern = "\\.metrics\\.txt$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

if (length(dup_files) == 0) {
  stop("No Picard MarkDuplicates metrics files found.")
}

duplication_df <- map_dfr(dup_files, read_picard_duplication)

# ----------------------------
# 4. Spike-in conversion rate
# ----------------------------
read_spikein_conversion <- function(f) {
  x <- data.table::fread(f)

  required_cols <- c(
    "sample",
    "conversion_2kb_2",
    "conversion_2kb_3_unmodified"
  )
  missing_cols <- setdiff(required_cols, names(x))
  if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
    stop(
      "Missing columns in spike-in summary file: ",
      paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", "),
      "\nFile: ", f
    )
  }

  x %>%
    transmute(
      sample = sample,
      conversion_2kb_2 = as.numeric(conversion_2kb_2),
      conversion_2kb_3 = as.numeric(conversion_2kb_3_unmodified)
    )
}

spikein_files <- list.files(
  file.path(results_dir, "qc", "spikein_prededup_methyldackel"),
  pattern = "\\.prededup\\.spikein\\.mergeContext\\.summary\\.tsv$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

if (length(spikein_files) == 0) {
  stop("No spike-in conversion summary files found.")
}

spikein_df <- map_dfr(spikein_files, read_spikein_conversion)

# ----------------------------
# 5. Mapping efficiency
# ----------------------------
read_mapping_efficiency <- function(f) {
  x <- data.table::fread(f)

  required_cols <- c("sample", "mapping_efficiency")
  missing_cols <- setdiff(required_cols, names(x))
  if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
    stop(
      "Missing columns in mapping efficiency file: ",
      paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", "),
      "\nFile: ", f
    )
  }

  x %>%
    transmute(
      sample = sample,
      mapping_efficiency = as.numeric(mapping_efficiency)
    )
}

mapping_files <- list.files(
  file.path(results_dir, "qc", "mapping_efficiency"),
  pattern = "\\.mapping_efficiency\\.tsv$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

mapping_files <- mapping_files[
  !basename(mapping_files) %in% "mapping_efficiency.all.tsv"
]

if (length(mapping_files) == 0) {
  stop("No mapping efficiency files found.")
}

mapping_df <- map_dfr(mapping_files, read_mapping_efficiency)

# ----------------------------
# 6. Merge, keep 7 columns, and save CSV
# ----------------------------
summary_df <- library_df %>%
  left_join(spikein_df, by = "sample") %>%
  left_join(coverage_df, by = "sample") %>%
  left_join(covered_cpg_df, by = "sample") %>%
  left_join(duplication_df, by = "sample") %>%
  left_join(mapping_df, by = "sample") %>%
  select(
    sample,
    library_conc,
    conversion_2kb_2,
    conversion_2kb_3,
    genomic_coverage,
    covered_cpgs,
    duplication_rate,
    mapping_efficiency
  )

write.csv(
  summary_df,
  metrics_csv,
  row.names = FALSE
)

summary_df
```

```{r read-benchmark-csv}
metrics_df <- read_csv(
  metrics_csv,
  col_names = TRUE,
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

benchmark_df <- meta %>%
  left_join(metrics_df, by = "sample") %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      c(
        library_conc,
        conversion_2kb_2,
        conversion_2kb_3,
        genomic_coverage,
        covered_cpgs,
        duplication_rate,
        mapping_efficiency
      ),
      as.numeric
    ),
    conversion_2kb_2_pct = 100 * conversion_2kb_2,
    conversion_2kb_3_pct = 100 * conversion_2kb_3,
    covered_cpgs_m = covered_cpgs / 1e6,
    duplication_pct = 100 * duplication_rate,
    mapping_efficiency_pct = 100 * mapping_efficiency,
    box_group = factor(
      paste(clinical_status, method, sep = "__"),
      levels = c(
        "AML__MOF-TAPS",
        "AML__TAPS+",
        "Healthy__MOF-TAPS",
        "Healthy__TAPS+"
      )
    ),
    x_plot = as.numeric(box_group),
    pair_id = interaction(clinical_status, sample_id, drop = TRUE)
  )
```

# Plot helpers

```{r plot-helper}
theme_benchmark <- function(show_legend = TRUE,
                            legend_position = "top",
                            legend_direction = "horizontal") {
  theme_classic(base_size = 12, base_family = font_family) +
    theme(
      panel.border = element_blank(),
      axis.line = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.4),
      axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.4),
      axis.ticks.length = unit(0.16, "cm"),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12, color = "black", margin = margin(t = 4)),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12, color = "black"),
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 12, color = "black"),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 12, color = "black", margin = margin(r = 8)),

      legend.position = if (show_legend) legend_position else "none",
      legend.direction = legend_direction,
      legend.justification = "center",

      legend.text = element_text(size = 12, color = "black", margin = margin(l = 2)),
      legend.title = element_blank(),
      legend.key = element_blank(),
      legend.key.height = unit(0.20, "cm"),
      legend.key.spacing.x = unit(0.20, "cm"),
      legend.key.spacing.y = unit(0.05, "cm"),

      legend.margin = margin(t = 0, r = 0, b = 0, l = 0),
      legend.box.margin = margin(t = 0, r = 0, b = 2, l = 0),
      legend.box.spacing = unit(0.12, "cm"),

      legend.background = element_blank(),
      legend.box.background = element_blank(),
      legend.box = "horizontal",

      plot.margin = margin(5, 10, 5, 10)
    )
}

status_rect_df <- tibble::tibble(
  clinical_status = factor(c("AML", "Healthy"), levels = clinical_status_order),
  xmin = c(0.5, 2.5),
  xmax = c(2.5, 4.5),
  xmid = c(1.5, 3.5),
  label = c("AML", "Healthy"),
  fill_color = unname(clinical_fill[c("AML", "Healthy")])
)

plot_metric_bar <- function(df,
                            y_var,
                            y_label,
                            show_legend = TRUE,
                            legend_position = "top",
                            legend_direction = "horizontal",
                            y_limits = NULL,
                            y_breaks = waiver(),
                            error_type = c("sem", "sd", "ci95")) {
  error_type <- match.arg(error_type)

  bar_df <- df |>
    dplyr::group_by(x_plot, box_group, method) |>
    dplyr::summarise(
      n = sum(!is.na(.data[[y_var]])),
      mean_value = mean(.data[[y_var]], na.rm = TRUE),
      sd_value = stats::sd(.data[[y_var]], na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      sem_value = dplyr::if_else(n > 1, sd_value / sqrt(n), 0),
      ci95_value = dplyr::if_else(
        n > 1,
        stats::qt(0.975, df = n - 1) * sem_value,
        0
      ),
      error_value = switch(
        error_type,
        sem = sem_value,
        sd = sd_value,
        ci95 = ci95_value
      ),
      error_value = tidyr::replace_na(error_value, 0),
      ymin_error = mean_value - error_value,
      ymax_error = mean_value + error_value
    )

  raw_max <- max(df[[y_var]], na.rm = TRUE)
  error_max <- max(bar_df$ymax_error, na.rm = TRUE)

  ymax <- if (is.null(y_limits)) {
    max(raw_max, error_max, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.08
  } else {
    y_limits[2]
  }

  ymin <- if (is.null(y_limits)) 0 else y_limits[1]

  status_ymin <- ymin - 0.12 * (ymax - ymin)
  status_ymax <- ymin - 0.04 * (ymax - ymin)
  status_label_y <- ymin - 0.08 * (ymax - ymin)

  ggplot(df, aes(x = x_plot, y = .data[[y_var]])) +
    geom_col(
      data = bar_df,
      aes(x = x_plot, y = mean_value, fill = method, group = box_group),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      width = 0.45,
      alpha = 0.72,
      color = "black",
      linewidth = 0.4
    ) +
    geom_errorbar(
      data = bar_df,
      aes(
        x = x_plot,
        ymin = ymin_error,
        ymax = ymax_error,
        group = box_group
      ),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      width = 0.16,
      linewidth = 0.45,
      color = "black"
    ) +
    geom_point(
      aes(fill = method),
      position = position_jitter(width = 0.12, height = 0),
      shape = 21,
      size = 2.4,
      color = "black",
      stroke = 0.35
    ) +
    geom_rect(
      data = status_rect_df,
      aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = status_ymin, ymax = status_ymax),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      fill = status_rect_df$fill_color,
      color = NA,
      alpha = 0.70,
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    geom_text(
      data = status_rect_df,
      aes(x = xmid, y = status_label_y, label = label),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      size = 3.2,
      family = font_family,
      color = "black"
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = c(method_colors, clinical_fill),
      breaks = method_order,
      limits = method_order,
      drop = FALSE
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = 1:4,
      labels = c("", "", "", ""),
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0.04, 0.04))
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0)),
      breaks = y_breaks
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(ymin, ymax), clip = "off") +
    labs(x = NULL, y = y_label) +
    theme_benchmark(
      show_legend = show_legend,
      legend_position = legend_position,
      legend_direction = legend_direction
    ) +
    theme(plot.margin = margin(5, 10, 5, 10))
}
```
